plan.rationale: The previous run's composition already handed every tick to toy_sweep_for_goal, so the stall was coverage, not wiring: this node set contains exactly one search behaviour and nothing that biases it toward unvisited frontier, so the honest repair is to keep the disclosure check as the single writer of goal_known at the head of tick order, give sweep the entire tick budget uninterrupted as the fallback's last resort (never sequenced behind the condition, which would starve it), and put the post-disclosure branch first so the instant the goal latches the tree switches over on the same tick. Inside that branch toy_avoid_obstacles leads because the route bends around occluding walls and it closes range while keeping clear, with toy_drive_to_goal as its recovery; gen_b_d6ae93648c7b4f25 is deliberately omitted because no node here reads speed_limit, so sequencing it ahead of a driving action would only starve that action rather than limit its speed.
